name: SvelteKit
tagline: The application framework built on Svelte and its compiler

seo.title: SvelteKit: Overview, Strengths, and Trade-offs
seo.description: What SvelteKit is, how its compiler-first model differs from React-based frameworks, and when it beats a content-first framework.

intro:
SvelteKit is the official application framework for Svelte. Svelte compiles components into imperative DOM updates at build time instead of shipping a runtime diffing library, which keeps bundles small without manual optimization. SvelteKit layers on routing, server routes, form actions, and adapters for different hosting targets.

Its model is closest to a traditional full-stack framework: you get shared layouts, server load functions, and progressive-enhancement form handling by default. Compared with a content-first framework, it puts more machinery in front of you from the start — which is the right trade when your site has genuine application state, and friction when it does not. This is a reference entry used by the comparison pages.
